public_source_basis.claim_used: DVOL supplies a forward-looking volatility regime and no directional input.
public_source_basis.claim_used_2: Perpetual premium links the contract to spot while open interest measures outstanding leveraged inventory.

mechanism.claim: During elevated implied volatility, an eight-hour premium-index displacement whose strict sign reverses the preceding block marks a derivatives-pressure rotation whose persistence depends on inventory sponsorship. Follow the new premium polarity when current OI expands and fade it when current OI contracts, for one eight-hour inventory cycle.
mechanism.side: product of the strict current premium-displacement sign and strict current OI-change sign
mechanism.why_distinct: HVPORC filters only OI expansion and always follows premium; HVOIRR filters an OI refill transition and always fades premium. HVPICR admits either strict OI sign and uses that sign as a direction-transform variable: sponsored rotations continue, inventory-closing rotations reverse. No prior event set, control, or clock is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: DVOL and absolute current premium displacement must each occupy their causal upper 40%.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: The derivatives-only polarity rotation with an OI-sign direction transform is absent from Gross9 definitions.

features.prior_premium_block: 480 exact unique BTCUSDT premium-index 1m rows in [D-16h,D-8h); finite strict-nonzero displacement
features.current_premium_block: 480 exact unique BTCUSDT premium-index 1m rows in [D-8h,D); finite strict-nonzero displacement
features.premium_rotation: strict signs of prior and current completed displacements are opposite
features.current_oi_block: 96 exact unique BTCUSDT 5m OI rows in [D-8h,D); finite positive endpoints and strict nonzero current log change
features.dvol_regime: exact completed DVOL hour ending D with positive close
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks over at most 270 source-valid boundaries, minimum 180; current excluded
features.eligibility: premium sign rotation, strict nonzero current OI change, abs(current premium displacement) rank>=0.60, and DVOL close rank>=0.60
features.availability: D after every constituent source row is complete

clock.side: follow current premium displacement when OI expands; fade it when OI contracts
clock.reservation: fixed nonoverlapping boundaries; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after novelty passes
clock.rv20: not a signal input; q90 audit only after unchanged all-stage economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent block-polarity rotation with contemporaneous leverage sponsorship

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure: source, novelty, train, test, eval, final; no threshold, side, hold, clock, subset, source, or control repair.
